title: Acceptance probability under proof reindexing
statement: Let $n$ be positive, let $w$ be a Boolean input word of length $n$, and let $p$ be a Boolean proof of length $2^n+2^{n^2}$. The quadratic input consistency tester's acceptance probability on the combined word $(w,p)$ equals the affine consistency tester's acceptance probability on $(w,q)$, where $q$ is the length-$2^n$ table obtained by reading the first $2^n$ proof entries in their indexed order.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean word of length $n$
$p$ is a Boolean proof of length $2^n+2^{n^2}$
